gen-luckiest-guy-gf-winky-sans: Winky Sans reads modern and unfussy, with capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Luckiest Guy, loud and cheerful, pours its ink at one width, and Winky Sans stays quietly beneath it.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-yantramanav: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, its strokes ending blunt with no tapering anywhere. Yantramanav is a plain sans that huddles its letters close, and its tall lowercase nearly reaches the capitals.
gen-luckiest-guy-plus-jakarta-sans: Loud, cheerful and built like poured ink. Plus Jakarta Sans follows with a precise monoline stroke and a lower lowercase, so the heading's tall letters get room to shout.
gen-luckiest-guy-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk is a geometric sans, drawn as a ribbon of constant width with counters that breathe wide open. Luckiest Guy earns its keep big and brief.
gen-megrim-fs-amulya: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters whose lowercase stands tall, every stroke ending at a measured thickness. Amulya, a contemporary sans, keeps generous gaps in its curves and sits lower, giving the heading space.
gen-megrim-fs-chillax: Futuristic angles meet relaxed, spaghetti-like curves. Megrim stretches its lowercase skyward, while Chillax, a casual sans-serif with pen-lifted loops left unfinished, stays lower and loosens everything up.
gen-megrim-fs-plein: Plein reads reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Megrim brings angular, futuristic lines with no pinched joints or flared ends, and its tall lowercase towers over Plein.
gen-megrim-fs-roundo: Roundo is a geometric sans whose n has arch and stem matching, and no small counter ever feels clogged. Megrim goes tall and angular; Roundo keeps the text moderate.
gen-megrim-fs-spline-sans: Angular, futuristic, sharply measured. Megrim lifts its lowercase high, and Spline Sans, approachable and contemporary, sits lower with wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-megrim-fs-synonym: Megrim's skyward lowercase gives it away, angular and futuristic with strokes ending at one measured thickness. And Synonym, a dependable sans-serif with generous curve openings, is the grounded partner that lowers the temperature.
